title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2025)
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Experience in C++, Java, Python, or Go. Knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
description: Work on core software infrastructure and applications, collaborate with full-time engineers, and tackle real-world scalability and computer science challenges.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom applying for a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.
qualification: Outstanding intellectual ability, leadership capacity, and commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Full-cost scholarship covering tuition, living allowance, and travel for outstanding applicants to pursue postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open globally to candidates with hands-on experience in modern JavaScript frameworks.
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), React, HTML5, CSS3, and modern web development tools.
description: Build high-performance web applications and user interfaces for WordPress.com and related products within a fully distributed, remote company culture.

title: Associate Data Analyst
eligibility: 0-2 years of professional experience in data analytics or business intelligence.
qualification: Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or Quantitative field. Proficiency in SQL and Python/R.
description: Analyze user metrics, build data dashboards, and collaborate with product managers to inform decision-making for core streaming features.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 18+ actively enrolled in high school or higher education worldwide.
qualification: Must create an innovative tech solution using Microsoft Azure AI and Cloud technologies.
description: Global student technology competition aimed at inspiring students to solve real-world problems using cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software design.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with no prior programming experience required.
qualification: Basic computer literacy and a passion for problem-solving.
description: An entry-level computer science course teaching algorithmic thinking, software principles, and languages including C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
